[![CloudNativePG](./logo/cloudnativepg.png)](https://cloudnative-pg.io/) # Barman Cloud CNPG-I plugin for CloudNativePG The documentation for the Barman Cloud Plugin for CloudNativePG is available at [https://cloudnative-pg.io/plugin-barman-cloud](https://cloudnative-pg.github.io/plugin-barman-cloud). --- The Barman Cloud CNPG-I plugin is a component of the [CloudNativePG project](https://github.com/cloudnative-pg) and adheres to the same community-driven [governance](GOVERNANCE.md) model under the [CNCF](https://cncf.io).
